caption:
J. Haja Funyamin dropped out of school in 6th grade and sold samosas on a Chennai street. On November 17, 2026, a Union Minister gave him an award named after JRD Tata.

Funyamin grew up in his family's small samosa business in Pudupet, Chennai. In 2008, he took a loan, bought a freezer, and started Hafa Foods from a rented unit in Red Hills. The company now reports Rs 15.58 crore in turnover, exporting frozen samosas to the UAE, the US, Canada, Singapore, and Sri Lanka.

On November 17, 2026, Union Minister Nitin Gadkari named him Entrepreneur of the Year at the JRD Tata Awards, instituted in tribute to the legendary industrialist.

He didn't leave the samosa business behind to build something bigger. He built something bigger out of the samosa business.

Sources: UNI India, India CSR
